title: Invariant matrix subalgebra and its explicit scalar-extension map
statement: Let K be a field, S its separable closure, n a natural number, and b:Gal(S/K) → GL_n(S) any function. Define the K-subalgebra A_b of Mat_n(S) with carrier {M | for every g, b(g) g(M) b(g) inverse = M}. Addition and multiplication are inherited from matrices. Define the S-algebra map S tensor_K A_b → Mat_n(S) by l tensor a ↦ l times a, with scalars embedded as scalar matrices. It sends 1 tensor a to the matrix a. These are real constructions without assuming any action laws or choosing algebra data.
